image_description: A male mallard duck (drake) floating on dark, rippling water. The duck features a glossy iridescent green head, a distinct white neck ring, a brown speckled chest, and greyish-brown body feathers. Its tail is curled upwards, displaying black and white feathers. The bill appears yellowish-green with a dark tip. Reflections of the duck are visible in the water.
